WITH OrderPrices AS (
    SELECT
        co.order_id,
        CASE
            WHEN pn.pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 12
            WHEN pn.pizza_name = 'Vegetarian' THEN 10
            ELSE 0
        END AS pizza_price,
        CASE
            WHEN co.extras IS NULL OR co.extras = '' THEN 0
            ELSE array_length(string_to_array(co.extras, ','))
        END AS extras_price
    FROM
        modern_data.main.pizza_customer_orders co
    JOIN
        modern_data.main.pizza_names pn ON co.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    JOIN
        modern_data.main.pizza_runner_orders ro ON co.order_id = ro.order_id
    WHERE
        (ro.cancellation IS NULL OR ro.cancellation = 'None') AND
        pn.pizza_name IN ('Meatlovers', 'Vegetarian')
)
SELECT
    SUM(pizza_price + extras_price) AS total_income
FROM
    OrderPrices;
